summary.en: ZenMux's Builder Plan (Free / Pro / Max / Ultra) on a subscription API key, with the rolling 5-hour and 7-day Flows and the monthly cap, read with a Management API key.
summary.zh: 用 ZenMux 订阅 API Key 接入 Builder Plan（Free / Pro / Max / Ultra），通过 Management API Key 读取滚动的 5 小时 / 7 天 Flows 额度与月度上限。
